title: Powerball Jackpot Odds Worsened 67%
hook: Powerball made an already remote jackpot 67% harder.
closing: Bigger jackpots came from making the winning ticket even less likely.
question: Would those odds stop you?

segments.say: Powerball's jackpot denominator is 292,201,338. A lifetime lightning strike is dramatically more likely.
A royal flush has a 649,740 denominator. That rare poker hand is still far easier.
The Powerball denominator rose to 292,201,338. The rule change made the jackpot harder to win.
